text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'd say our mascot research is coming
along
swimmingly, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Good question. I think it's about time we
tried
putting our research to use... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo!
My head's gonna explode!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a break for now. Pushing
ourselves hard
won't guarantee res—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I think I get it. So you've been
invited to appear at a shopping district's
50th anniversary event, but it doesn't
seem like many people will
show up?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
More specifically, we want to bring in
enough people to remind everyone of
the hustle and
bustle this place had in
the old days.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's such a big day. We wanna
clear out the cobwebs and get that warm
neighborhood
atmosphere back, and...
uh, stuff. You know?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I do know! This sounds like it could be the perfect job for Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If I become the mascot for this event, I can save the day and get my name out there. It's a win-win. Please, please let me help out.
choice_data_list: Time for the practical stuff, then!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! We're having a 50th
anniversary
celebration! Come check it
out! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We've got live music, a raffle, and loads
more! It's
going to be tons of fun!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...You weren't kidding. No one comes
down this
way, do they?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems that foot traffic has slowed to a
trickle
ever since a big shopping center
was constructed
nearby.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Here's someone.
Hi! We're having a
50th ann—
choice_data_list: Let's try moving to another spot!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: I-I'm good, thanks...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the way he avoided eye
contact and the speed at which he
walked past us... it's likely
he mistook us
for everyday peddlers passing out flyers
and tissues.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You don't say... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The mark of a true mascot is the ability
to gather
crowds in times like this.
Which means, it's
Machan time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Sorry for the wait.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I see. Our signature racewear is our
 trademark. You have determined that
wearing yours is the most effective way
to draw attention
to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Well,
that plus a nice smile,
aaand...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: A high five. Perfect.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
N-no way... So we should probably
change into
our racewear too, huh?!
choice_data_list: That's the fruit of your research!
That's the fruit of your research!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you an active runner?! Wow...
Your
signature racewear is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that takes me back... Why, I
remember when
Umamusume in training
used to pass through
here...

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
Remember when that local girl won her
first race?
Everyone was so excited...
Didn't we throw her a
party?

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been here in ages... Ah! The
fish market
lady's still here! Nice to see
her shop's still open!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
People actually showed up! Thank
goodness!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
They did. And I heard that today felt
like a stroll
down memory lane for the
shopkeepers as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, today was terrific.
But I still have a
ways to
go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A mascot for a local shopping district
only has so much reach, and my ambition
burns much brighter. I want to be the
mascot for the whole
world.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The mascot for the world?! If you pull that off, all the pictures from today are gonna be super rare "early years" collector's items someday, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan will probably end up too
successful to act as a mascot for a quaint
shopping district,
so a day like today
might not come to pass again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sure. Can you record some audio as
well?
choice_data_list: Once you become an even bigger deal...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. A-hem... Hi. This is Aston
Machan. Today, I helped out with the
50th anniversary
event for a shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And I'm joined here by my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Someday, this person will be known as
the one
who trained the best mascot in
the world. Isn't
that right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly and decisively. Machan
holds out her smartphone expectantly,
so I offer up my own
sound bite: "I'm
Machan's trainer."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, we'll probably
be renting out huge venues to hold
Machan events for lots
of people to
attend.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And of course, people will want to visit
all the key locations from my career's
early days, which will
draw attention to
this shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Oh, but don't forget...
choice_data_list: Anyway, that means a lot of people...
Anyway, that means a lot of people...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how famous I get, I'll always
stay by
your side. I'll never let you feel
like any distance
has grown between us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Machan gazes at me knowingly, I
can't help but break into a smile. It's a
strange closeness we
share, but
somehow I find it oddly comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It sure was.
...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Oh,
it's nothing. I was just thinking
about
how easy it is to forget the good
times.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want people to dwell on the
sad stuff. I want them to look back on
today and think,
"Machan sure was
cute!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think she might be right there.
Reflecting on her words, I resolve to
treasure happy moments like
today for
the rest of my life.
